body:
Resolve Wave 2 audit findings:
1. In lib/scheduler.mjs:
   - In checkConsensusFixCandidateRails around line 2046: import and use loadActiveRails(repo) from ./active-rails.mjs to union store-level active ticket rails with candidateRails. If active-rails loading fails or returns unconsultable, abort the consensus fix with { ok: false, error: 'failed to verify active rails' }.
   - Ensure the consensus fix rail verification fails closed: any rail violation or check error prevents fix application and returns { ok: false }.
2. In lib/doctor.mjs:
   - In checkTicketStore around line 1196: if adlc ticket doctor fails with ENOENT or exit 127, return { status: 'warn', message: 'adlc binary not found or failed to execute ticket doctor' } instead of falling through to PASS.
   - In runDoctor around line 1243: pass options to checkNodeVersion(options) so that programmatic calls with custom version requirements are respected.
3. In scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs:
   - Update CALL_PATTERN regex on line 25 to match numbered require identifiers emitted by esbuild: /\b(?:import|require\d*)\s*\(([^)]+)\)/g.
   - Add a test in test/check-bundle-externals.test.mjs asserting that require2('some-pkg') is caught.

Verification: npm test && node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs
title: Wave 2: Scheduler and Doctor Gate Hardening
